text: One for the tracker: What is the site for the store whose appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift at Marrow Agrisupply? I need it for the QBR deck.
reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in the #inc-tansley-carrier-api thread: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

Priyanka raised it in #central-team on 2026-06-09. Pine Crossing's morning receiver said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note.

I also mentioned Eastbank, the other Marrow Agrisupply store in that thread. Its problem was mislabelled doors in an import file (ticket PD-4821), so it's a different issue.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can already see all of this. None of it involves money, so no approval was needed.
